title: Evidence-bound proof-carrying projection
problem: A syntactically complete checkpoint trace can still be semantically empty or supported by one common faulty source.
rules: Every required PASS role must have at least one verified evidence witness.
An open defeater targeting a required role downgrades terminal PASS to UNKNOWN.
For empirical authority, an open defeater blocks acceptance.
Residual doubts are recorded explicitly rather than silently erased.
Evidence-source roots are tracked so common-mode dependency can be measured.
common_mode_metric: root blast radius = number of required PASS roles that lose all verified witness support if one declared source root fails
invariants: PASS without witness is not authority
Common evidence roots create common-mode epistemic fragility
Defeaters belong in the official proof object, not outside the argument
boundary: Witness verification and root declarations are still model inputs; this contract exposes dependence and unresolved challenge but does not prove a witness is scientifically true.
